sources.label: Xbox Wire

Never Played Football Manager Before? Here are Some First-Timer Tips Before Football Manager 27 Arrives
The World Cup brought a lot of new eyes to football (soccer, if you must), which in turn is sure to bring a lot of new players to Football Manager 27 . But this simulation series is so realistic that it’s helped kickstart the careers of professional managers, its database is used by real clubs, and the greats of the game – on and off-field – are avowed fans. That commitment to realism means it could also seem overwhelming to get started for the very first time.
Ahead of the latest entry’s launch for XBOX on PC and XBOX Series X|S – with both versions available with Game Pass – I spoke to Sports Interactive Senior Features Manager, Ant Farley on the Official XBOX Podcast about how the game caters to new players as well as die-hard fans. If you’re looking to step into the dugout for the first time, here’s how you can make your managerial debut with confidence:
The joy and the challenge of Football Manager is that it offers the ability to do almost everything a real-life manager does: “It’s more of a strategy simulation title than an action title,” explains Farley. “You’re not controlling the players – really it’s about the core areas of what a real life football manager or head coach does: They’re making transfers, buying new players, training their team, setting the tactics, managing finances and budgets. What we’re trying to do is simulate the job of a real football manager.”
“So you can kind of tailor their experience that you want from it. You could play an FM save where all you’re doing is picking your tactics and playing the matches, or you can really go into the big detail of taking care of everything, micromanaging every element of what goes on at your football club. We give you those options.”
Football Manager 27 has a new feature that can further help players to achieve what they want without navigating multiple menus mid-match: “We’ve introduced a cool new feature called Tactical Tweaks this year, which I think will be really helpful for people that don’t know football that well or don’t know FM that well,” Farley explains. “The tactical side of the match simulation can be a bit intimidating, so what we’ve done with Tactical Tweaks is effectively give you a single button to press that will make multiple changes.”
Developed after talking with real-life professionals, the new system is designed to better emulate what it feels like to be a manager barking orders to your players amid the din of a stadium. “What that button’s doing is making a bunch of different tactical changes in the system, but you’re not having to navigate those menus. And crucially, you’re doing that from the touchline, so you feel a lot more of an active participant in those matches.”
The thing about Football Manager is that, by emulating the real-life game, it also emulates its pure unpredictability. As Farley puts it: “We’re in a maybe unique position as a game where you can kind of make all of the right choices and all the right decisions and still lose the game, right? That’s how football is.”
But with that breadth comes complexity, and there are measures in place to help players take on what they’d like to play with. “We have a lot of in-game sort of mechanics that help with that onboarding,” Farley continues. “Let’s just say you’re new to the game and buying players is something that really excites you – but maybe the training, not so much. That might be something you want to get around to a little bit later into your journey. We have the option to delegate that to your staff members.

sources.label: PlayStation Blog
sources.evidenceText:
A variety of influences come together to create intense action-RPG combat and a strange and fascinating world.
Phantom Blade Zero: How boss weapons transform combat and exploration
Phantom Blade Zero blends influences from a variety of sources to create intense, fast-paced combat and a supernaturally infused Kungfupunk world. It draws on the tough, powerful bosses of Soulslikes, the quick, combo-focused combat of hack-and-slash games, the fascinating stories and characters of RPGs, and the unlockable exploration of search action games. All those ideas come together to create something familiar and unexpected, reworking common action-RPG elements into beautiful, fast-paced battles across a strange, devastated world.
While Phantom Blade Zero’s combat evokes games like Sekiro: Shadows Die Twice and Bloodborne, it takes a more hybrid approach, channeling Wuxia stories and kung-fu movies. You’re not just using R1 to dodge, holding L1 to block blows, or tapping L1 to parry them; you also need to press attack, using Square for basic attacks and Triangle for more powerful blows to create simple but effective combos and force your opponent to block and parry as well.
It’s all about managing a meter measuring your Sha-Chi. Blocking attacks depletes your Sha-Chi, and if it runs out, you can be staggered and left open to attack — but perfectly parrying, and dodging and landing blows knocks down your opponent’s Sha-Chi instead, letting you cut through their defenses.

sources.evidenceText:
After making a cameo in Astro Bot (2024), it is now Rayman’s turn to dress up as the Captain of the Bots.
Suit up as Astro Bot in Rayman Legends Retold
Rayman Legends Retold is coming to PlayStation 5 and PlayStation 5 Pro on December 3, and Astro Bot’s iconic design is featured in the game as an exclusive costume, bringing the iconic platformer pairing full circle after Rayman made a cameo in Astro Bot (2024).
The PS5-exclusive Astro Bot costume in Rayman Legends Retold will be available for free on players’ first visit to Victor Velour, the game’s resident tailor, at his costume shop. The outfit is once again a collaboration between Ubisoft Milan, Ubisoft Montpellier, and Team Asobi. We sat down with Guillaume Arvieu, Art and World Director on Rayman Legends Retold, and Quentin Chaillet, Lead Character Artist, to discuss the collaboration, how the costume was created, and the DNA shared by two platforming icons.
Talk us through the Astro Bot skin design in Rayman Legends Retold – how did you approach capturing the essence of Astro Bot within your own art style?  
Chaillet: One of the biggest challenges was bringing Astro Bot’s sleek, futuristic aesthetic into Rayman’s universe. Rayman’s designs traditionally have a more handcrafted, organic feel, so introducing these glossy surfaces, metallic details, and high-tech materials was something quite different from what we’re used to.
We wanted to stay as faithful as possible to Astro Bot’s iconic design while making sure it still felt authentically Rayman. That meant carefully adapting the shapes and proportions, especially his large nose, no arms / legs, and his big shoes, which are such recognizable parts of Rayman’s silhouette.
The goal was to incorporate as many of Astro Bot’s signature details as possible, from the reflective metallic parts and glowing blue elements to the smooth white surfaces, without losing Rayman’s personality or expressiveness.

《影之刃零》Metacritic获88分 成该站评分最高中国游戏
S-Game开发的“功夫朋克”动作游戏《 影之刃零 》评测解禁后，在Metacritic取得88分。按当时的聚合结果计算，本作成为该站评分最高的中国游戏。
《影之刃零》在OpenCritic取得91分，媒体推荐率为100%。专业媒体评分主要集中在8至10分，快节奏战斗系统、经过细致设计的首领战以及结构较为复杂的关卡设计均获得肯定。这些评价也让本作成为当年动作游戏奖项的有力竞争者。
《影之刃零》将于10月29日登陆PC和PS，聚合评分还可能随新增评测发生变化，88分及相关排名均对应当时的查询结果。

packages.headline: PS5/PC注目の大作『Phantom Blade Zero』、まだ発売前なのに「もう100万本以上売れてそう」との調査レポート。60％以上が中国の売上、予約だけでヒット

sources.label: AUTOMATON
sources.evidenceText:
S-GAMEは10月29日、『Phantom Blade Zero』を発売予定。本作はすでに、ダウンロード版の予約売上だけで85万本に達していると推計されている。
PS5/PC注目の大作『Phantom Blade Zero』、まだ発売前なのに「もう100万本以上売れてそう」との調査レポート。60％以上が中国の売上、予約だけでヒット
デベロッパーのS-GAMEは10月29日、『 Phantom Blade Zero 』を発売予定。対応プラットフォームはPS5/PC（Steam/Epic Gamesストア）で、日本語表示に対応する。明日の発売が迫るなか、市場調査会社Alinea Analyticsは発売前の本作がすでに、ダウンロード版の売上だけで85万本に達したと推計している。
『Phantom Blade Zero』は、暗黒武侠アクションアドベンチャーゲームだ。本作の舞台となるのは、スチームパンクやオカルトなどが融合した架空の武侠世界「影界」。主人公は、主君殺しの濡れ衣を着せられ、心臓に深手を負った剣客だ。余命わずかとなった彼は、陰謀はびこる世界を駆け巡り、黒幕を見つけ出そうとする。剣刃が飛び交い、血と雨が降る戦場にて、愛憎入り交じる己探しの旅が繰り広げられる。
ちなみに『Phantom Blade Zero』の開発元S-GAMEも、『黒神話：悟空』の大ヒットのおかげで多額の資金調達に成功したことも報じられていた（ 関連記事 ）。また『黒神話：悟空』は中国での大型シングルプレイゲーム人気の火付け役にもなったようで、Leenzeeが手がけ2025年7月に発売された『明末：ウツロノハネ』も今年7月に累計プレイヤー数が500万人を記録している。
中国発の大型シングルプレイゲームが勢いに乗るなかで、満を持して発売される『Phantom Blade Zero』。予約販売本数だけでもかなり好調のようで、『黒神話：悟空』に続いて大ヒットをあげられるかどうかは注目される。また予約の時点では中国での販売本数が過半数を占めているものの、先述した『黒神話：悟空』のように、グローバルな人気を拡大していくかどうかにも関心が高まる。
『Phantom Blade Zero』は、 PS5 /PC（ Steam / Epic Gamesストア ）向けに10月29日発売予定だ。
本作は2023年に発表され、Unreal Engine 5にて構築された重厚なグラフィックや、アクション映画スターのドニー・イェン氏がクリエイティブコンサルタントを務めていることなどから注目を集めてきた。当初は発売日が2026年9月9日と告知されたが、後に10月29日に発売延期となることが発表（ 関連記事 ）。このたびついに発売を迎える。

packages.headline: 'Appreciate the Fans' — GTA 5 Cast Tell Jason and Lucia’s Actors the Most Important Things They Should Know Before GTA 6 Launches Them to Fame

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
The stars behind GTA 5’s Franklin, Michael, and Trevor, along with the voice of CJ from San Andreas, were asked if they had any advice for the actors playing GTA 6’s Jason and Lucia now that the game is almost here.
'Appreciate the Fans' — GTA 5 Cast Tell Jason and Lucia’s Actors the Most Important Things They Should Know Before GTA 6 Launches Them to Fame
The long wait for GTA 6 is almost over. After 13 years, the game is finally set to release on November 19 in one of the biggest (and potentially most expensive) pop culture moments in history.
Knowing just how passionate Rockstar’s fanbase can be, actors who starred in previous games in the franchise shared their words of wisdom with the as-yet unannounced actors who are playing Jason and Lucia, the dual protagonists of GTA 6, in an interview with All Out Gaming at MCM Comic Con.
“To be honest, just listen to what Rockstar says,” Shawn ‘Solo’ Fonteno, famous for playing Franklin in GTA 5, added. “They’re gonna lead you in the right direction. … But get ready. That’s all I can say, is get ready. It’s a ride that they’re gonna be on for a while.”
Young Maylay continued, remarking on how the GTA games have garnered dedicated fanbases from multiple generations of players. “We’ll always be the characters that we are, and for the generation of kids who are coming up, you’re gonna have certain brackets,” he said.
“Right now, I got all the OGs. Everybody coming in my line — you catch some youngsters, but you got guys with the grey hair coming in saying, ‘Hey man! You’re the guy, CJ!’ And they [gesturing to the GTA 5 cast] have all the youngsters right now. So, during this time period, you’re gonna grow with your fanbase. It’s not like everything’s gonna get shut down by you guys [speaking of GTA 6]… we’ll always be those characters, and you can’t take that from us.”
Ned Luke, who played Michael De Santa in GTA 5 , urged the upcoming stars to be grateful for the game’s fans. “Just make sure that you appreciate the fans. Let the fans know… fake appreciation, they can smell it. You have to really appreciate them, genuinely, because what we have is because of them. If you don’t have the fans, you don’t got nothin’. They’re the game, and that’s the bottom line,” he imparted.
"Fake appreciation, they can smell it."

packages.headline: Alien: Isolation 2 Team Confirms Physical Edition, Photo Mode, and New Gameplay Details

sources.label: IGN Games
sources.evidenceText:
The team behind Alien: Isolation 2 released a Q&A that reveals new gameplay details, including using your real-life microphone, a physical edition, a photo mode, and more.
Alien: Isolation 2 Team Confirms Physical Edition, Photo Mode, and New Gameplay Details
The team at Creative Assembly released a 17-minute video outlining its vision for Alien: Isolation 2 by answering fan questions about the game, and there's a lot to look forward to. For starters, players can expect a physical edition of the game when it launches in 2027. That means it will beat the deadline to be published on a disc, just ahead of PlayStation's all-digital shift in 2028. The game will also boast a photo mode, which aims to be "everything you expect from a camera."
Alien: Isolation 2 will be set months after the first game and, as revealed in a trailer , it will take place partially outside, which will allow the Xenomorph to behave differently. It will use the wider environment to hunt you more effectively by taking advantage of the rough weather and lack of claustrophobic environments where you can typically hear or see it coming. The team is once again trying to tap into the feeling of the original film, where a singular Xenomorph is hunting you as opposed to a whole army of them.
Snap a selfie with the Xenomorph.
They're working hard to feature all of the detailed settings you'd expect from an actual camera, such as depth of field, lighting options, filters that call back to the original films, and more. As for the team building this game, about a third of the original crew that made the first title are working on the sequel, but they were looking for big fans when interviewing staff for the initial game. Lead game designer James Green called the sequel a "dream project."
